invariants.text: Product.product_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Customer.customer_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.sale_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Sale.customer_id must reference an existing Customer.customer_id
Sale.product_id must reference an existing Product.product_id
The total_price of a sale must equal the price of the product multiplied by the quantity sold.
The stock_quantity of a product must not go below zero after a sale is recorded.
Each sale must be associated with a valid customer and a valid product.
A product's stock_quantity must be updated only when a sale is recorded for that product.
A sale must have a sale_date that is not in the future.
The same customer cannot be associated with multiple sales unless each sale is a separate transaction.
The product_id in a sale must reference a product that exists in the Product table.
The customer_id in a sale must reference a customer that exists in the Customer table.
The quantity of a product sold in a sale must be a positive integer.
The total number of units sold across all sales for a product must not exceed the product's stock_quantity at any point in time.
